# Manuscript figures

These are the figures of the manuscript *Digital wellbeing in the social media era: dual pathway analysis of emotional and behavioural distress indicators and public health utility* (Younas & Anande, under submission).

**Where they come from.** They were generated by the enhanced analysis code at [Tertsegha1/digital-wellbeing-distress-signals](https://github.com/Tertsegha1/digital-wellbeing-distress-signals), which builds on the dual-pathway analysis first developed in this repository. They are **not** outputs of `Mental_Health_Vs_Social_Media.ipynb`.

**Datasets.**
- *Emotional pathway:* the same Twitter corpus as this repository's notebook (*Depression: Twitter Dataset + Feature Extraction*, Kaggle).
- *Behavioural pathway:* two synthetic datasets.
  - *Digital Habits vs. Mental Health* (Kaggle).
  - This repository's *Social Media vs Productivity* dataset, re-analysed with the same leakage-free pipeline. With stress at 6 or more, behaviour does not predict stress (random forest AUC 0.506). Stress in this dataset is essentially independent of every behaviour.
